description: DeepSeek-only PPO-facing text feature contract selected after schema diagnostics. It keeps compact directional/risk state features and adds source-quality gates so downstream PPO can separate investable signal from boilerplate.

features.name: text_alpha_direction
features.meaning: Net investable directional evidence after balancing positive and negative document signals.

features.name: text_downside_risk
features.meaning: Net downside risk intensity from the document.

features.name: text_uncertainty
features.meaning: Uncertainty, conditionality, weak modal language, or unclear outlook.

features.name: text_macro_stress
features.meaning: Macro or cross-asset stress relevant to the ticker or portfolio.

features.name: text_earnings_pressure
features.meaning: Direction and severity of earnings, revenue, margin, EPS, or guidance pressure.

features.name: text_balance_sheet_stress
features.meaning: Leverage, liquidity, funding, working-capital, refinancing, or solvency pressure.

features.name: text_signal_confidence
features.meaning: Confidence that the text signal is specific, timely, and not boilerplate.

features.name: text_evidence_specificity
features.meaning: How specific and document-grounded the evidence is, rather than vague or generic.

features.name: text_numeric_evidence_density
features.meaning: Density of useful numeric financial, operating, margin, cash-flow, balance-sheet, or guidance evidence.

features.name: text_boilerplate_intensity
features.meaning: Generic repeated disclosure or legal boilerplate intensity that should reduce trust in semantic signal.
